test_compression_boundary_hook_fires: test that on_session_start hook fires with boundary_reason compression when context compresses and rotates session_id
test_no_hook_without_session_db: test that compression boundary hook does not fire when AIAgent has no session_db configured
test_hook_failure_does_not_break_compres: test that compression still completes successfully even if the on_session_start hook raises an exception
compress_context_with_session_rotation: compress agent context messages and verify session_id rotates when a SessionDB is attached to the agent
make_agent_with_session_db: create an AIAgent instance with a SessionDB for testing compression boundary hook behavior
